stories.title: Laver Cup 2026 — Day 1 Lineup Set, Starts Tomorrow

x_posts.label: Post 1-1

Day 1 Laver Cup lineup is set. 🎾

Day session 1 PM local:
• Ruud vs Cerúndolo
• Menšík vs Nakashima

Night session 7 PM:
• Jódar vs Bublik (both debutants)
• Alcaraz/Menšík vs Fritz/Bublik (doubles)

Zverev not on until Day 2. #LaverCup #tennis

Team Europe: Alcaraz. Zverev. Ruud. Menšík. Cobolli. Jódar.

Team World: Fritz. De Minaur. Bublik. Tien. Cerúndolo. Nakashima.

Europe leads all-time 8-1. Team World are the defending champions.

This weekend is everything. 🎾 #LaverCup

research.facts:
Laver Cup 2026 — Day 1 Lineup (T1)
**Freshness:** Lineup published today (Sep 24) by lavercup.com
**Cross-verification:** Day session confirmed by skysports.com, tennis365.com, atptour.com, olympics.com, yahoo sports
**Key verified facts (HIGH confidence):**
- Day session 1 PM local BST: Match 1 — Casper Ruud (EUR) vs. Francisco Cerúndolo (World); Match 2 — Jakub Menšík (EUR) vs. Brandon Nakashima (World)
- Night session 7 PM local BST: Match 3 — Rafael Jódar (EUR) vs. Alexander Bublik (World); Match 4 Doubles — Carlos Alcaraz/Jakub Menšík (EUR) vs. Taylor Fritz/Alexander Bublik (World)
- Alcaraz does not play singles Day 1 — confirmed by multiple sources
- Venue: The O2 Arena, London, indoor hard court
- Format: 1 point per match Day 1, 2 pts Day 2, 3 pts Day 3; first to 13 wins
- All-time series: Europe leads 8-1; Team World are defending champions (2025 San Francisco, 15-9)
- Ruud vs Cerúndolo note: Cerúndolo beat Ruud at 2024 Laver Cup (only Laver Cup singles loss for Ruud)
- Jódar note: 20-year-old Spanish debutant
- Alcaraz quote (ATP Tour): "He is probably the best player in the world right now, so having him by my side is going to be a great weapon..." (about Zverev)
- Zverev quote (lavercup.com): "I always love being part of the Laver Cup. The team atmosphere is incredible, and the intensity is unlike anything else we play all year."

China Open draw is expected Sep 28. Tournament starts Sep 30.

No decision yet. Clock is ticking. #Sinner #ATP
